items.title: 〈華邦電展望〉晶圓龍頭傳跨足3D DRAM 焦佑鈞：台積追求卓越 不會做半調子
items.title_en: <Wah Boon Electronics Outlook> Wafer Leader Rumored to Enter 3D DRAM; Jiao Youjun: TSMC Pursues Excellence and Won’t Do Half‑Measures
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(7)日舉辦 2026 年度家庭日，晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)近期傳出有意為輝達(NVIDIA)生產 3D DRAM，藉此進軍先進記憶體領域，引發半導體供應鏈高度關注。記憶體大廠華邦電董事長焦佑鈞受訪時指出，台積電是一家追求卓越的公司，若真有規劃跨足 DRAM 市場，絕不可能做半吊子，必定會在技術完全成熟前選擇默默進行，不會輕易釋出未準備好的訊息。
焦佑鈞分析，晶圓代工大廠若要跨入 DRAM 領域，首要面臨的正是技術自主與龐大的專利壁壘。DRAM 技術無法憑空而來，企業必須審慎評估是否願意投入鉅額資金進行自主研發，同時還需處理極為複雜的記憶體專利。
此外，台積電目前與三星、華邦電等各大記憶體廠在先進封裝領域均保持緊密的合作關係，在既有生態系合作良好的基礎下，自行跳下來跨界開發 DRAM 產品的可能性並不高。
針對 AI 資料中心資本支出議題，焦佑鈞指出，台積電與整體供應鏈在 2027 至 2028 年的裝機需求極為確定，雲端服務業者(CSP)的前期投資與設備均已到位。
然而，若總體經濟資金限制逐漸顯現，2029 年半導體產業恐迎來下一波景氣調整，屆時先進封裝與記憶體供應鏈的產能配比將成為市場觀察重點。
paras_en: Wah Boon Electronics (2344‑TW) held its 2026 Family Day today (the 7th). Recently, wafer‑foundry giant TSMC (2330‑TW) is rumored to be interested in producing 3D DRAM for NVIDIA, aiming to break into the advanced memory market, which has drawn intense attention across the semiconductor supply chain. In an interview, Wah Boon’s chairman Jiao Youjun said TSMC is a company that strives for excellence; if it truly plans to step into the DRAM market, it would never do a half‑hearted job and would keep any activity under wraps until the technology is fully mature, avoiding the release of unprepared information.

Jiao explained that for a major foundry to enter the DRAM field, the primary challenges are technological independence and massive patent barriers. DRAM technology cannot be invented out of thin air; a company must carefully assess whether it is willing to invest huge sums in independent R&D while also navigating an extremely complex web of memory patents.

Moreover, TSMC already maintains close collaborations with leading memory makers such as Samsung and Wah Boon in the advanced packaging arena. Given the strong existing ecosystem partnerships, the likelihood of TSMC abruptly jumping into DRAM product development on its own is low.

Addressing AI data‑center capital‑expenditure issues, Jiao noted that TSMC and the broader supply chain have a very clear outlook for equipment demand in 2027‑2028, with cloud service providers (CSPs) already having made their upfront investments and secured the necessary equipment.

However, if overall economic financing constraints become more pronounced, the semiconductor industry could face its next cyclical adjustment in 2029. At that point, the capacity balance between advanced packaging and memory supply chains will become a key focus for the market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉華航客貨運業績暢旺 股價創3個月來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: China Airlines' Passenger and Cargo Operations Thrive, Stock Hits 3-Month High
paras: 華航(2610-TW)第三季暑期客運業績暢旺，第四季又迎來貨運傳統旺季，同時國際油價有望回跌，使本周股價在台股大回檔之際，相對有撐，周漲逾5%，最高來到22.15元創8月以來新高價位。
華航第三季稅後純益44.2億元，年增49.56%，每股純益(EPS)0.72元，創單季第三高紀錄，而前三季稅後純益110.02億元，年增0.05%，EPS 1.8元，儘管面臨高油價，仍有效穩住獲利動能。
展望第四季，華航看好，空運迎來旺季，可望帶動傳產、電商等其他空運主力產品拉貨潮，預估可支撐整體貨運需求續強。
法人分析，明年AI 產業將持續帶動電子產品空運需求，而華航預計新增 4 架 777-F 貨機，空運成長動能可期。
另一方面，在中東戰爭影響逐漸降低下，法人預估明年航空燃油均價將小幅低於今年，有助航空業獲利處成長趨勢。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610-TW) saw strong passenger performance in Q3 summer, and Q4 welcomes the traditional cargo peak season, while international oil prices are expected to fall, giving its stock relative support during a broad market pullback; the stock rose over 5% for the week, reaching a high of NT$22.15, a new peak since August.

China Airlines posted Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$4.42 billion, up 49.56% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.72, the third‑quarter highest on record, while net profit for the first three quarters was NT$11.002 billion, up 0.05% YoY, EPS NT$1.80; despite high fuel costs, it effectively maintained profit momentum.

Looking ahead to Q4, the airline is optimistic; air freight enters its peak season and is expected to drive a cargo surge from traditional manufacturers, e‑commerce and other major air‑freight shippers, supporting continued strong overall cargo demand.

Institutional analysts note that the AI industry will continue to boost demand for air transport of electronic products next year, and China Airlines plans to add four 777‑F freighters, giving its cargo growth momentum.

Meanwhile, as the impact of the Middle East war gradually diminishes, analysts forecast that average jet fuel prices next year will be slightly lower than this year, helping the airline industry's profit growth trend.

paras: 2026高雄國際金融博覽會11月6至8日高雄展覽館登場，集合國內外金融機構，以ETF投資、TISA帳戶及家族辦公室為三大主軸。公股銀行攜手進駐亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區，兆豐金控 （2886-TW）、第一銀行、臺灣企銀 (2834-TW）、彰化銀行（2801-TW）與土地銀行分別以超跑賽事、港灣意象、工藝美學與AI互動打造沉浸式展區，土銀更祭出抽獎東京來回機票及Apple Watch等活動，搶攻普惠金融與高端財富管理商機。

兆豐金控今年以「兆豐財富超跑賽」為主題，集結兆豐銀行、兆豐投信、兆豐證券及兆豐期貨四大事業體。現場展示機器人理財「理財e把兆」、美股盤前交易與每股GO服務、兆期Pro策略交易平台及四大ETF投資主題，並設計「ETF神配對」等互動遊戲與電子集章闖關。兆豐銀行機器人理財結合晨星（Morningstar）專業機制，基金最低新台幣2000元、ETF最低3000元即可投資；兆豐證券美股GO享手續費均一價且無低收門檻。民眾集滿4個電子章可兌換限定好禮，體驗機器人理財還可享用冰沙。

彰化銀行呼應亞洲資產管理中心落地高雄，以「彰銀泊樂港」主題館參展，聚焦TISA全民資產累積與高資產家族傳承。「TISA泊樂互動區」以「從1000元開始，TISA基金・築夢未來」為主題，推出碼頭闖關遊戲與講座，引導民眾透過網路銀行辦理TISA基金定期定額。「亞灣海境貴賓室」則舉辦家族辦公室資產規劃講座並提供一對一諮詢。參加高資產或TISA講座均可獲得專屬禮品。
土地銀行結合AI互動與數位問答打造三大專區。「ETF投資專區」導入AI互動協助民眾篩選近百檔ETF；「TISA帳戶服務區」設數位問答遊戲宣導信託與長期理財；「家族辦公室服務區」則提供AI拍照體驗模擬高資產情境。完成三大專區體驗可獲贈限量精美贈品，展覽期間更提供東京來回機票、Apple Watch及Dyson吹風機等抽獎活動。

paras_en: The 2026 Kaohsiung International Financial Expo will be held from November 6 to 8 at the Kaohsiung Exhibition Center, gathering domestic and overseas financial institutions around three main themes: ETF investing, TISA accounts, and family offices. State-owned banks are joining the Asian Asset Management Center's Kaohsiung zone, with Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), First Bank, Taiwan Business Bank (2834‑TW), Changhua Bank (2801‑TW) and Land Bank each creating immersive booths featuring super‑car races, harbor imagery, craft aesthetics and AI interaction. Land Bank is also offering a raffle for round‑trip Tokyo airfare and Apple Watches, targeting both inclusive finance and high‑end wealth‑management opportunities.

Mega Financial Holding’s theme this year is the “Mega Wealth Super‑Car Race,” bringing together its four core businesses: Mega Bank, Mega Investment Trust, Mega Securities and Mega Futures. The booth showcases the robot‑advisor “Wealth e‑Ba,” pre‑market U.S. stock trading with per‑share GO service, the Mega Futures Pro strategy platform, and four ETF investment themes, plus interactive games such as “ETF Match‑Making” and electronic stamp challenges. Mega Bank’s robot‑advisor integrates Morningstar’s professional methodology, allowing investments as low as NT$2,000 for funds and NT$3,000 for ETFs; Mega Securities’ U.S. stock GO service offers a flat commission with no minimum purchase. Visitors who collect four electronic stamps can redeem limited‑edition gifts, and those who try the robot‑advisor receive a complimentary smoothie.

First Bank is participating for the first time with a “High‑Asset Business” focus, creating the “First Navigation – Realm of Abundance” exhibition area. Visuals echo Kaohsiung’s Asia Bay harbor motif and display the results of its Wealth Management 2.0 high‑asset services over five years, as well as Kaohsiung‑zone offerings and family‑office services. As one of the first banks to enter the Kaohsiung zone, First Bank now serves over 500 zone clients, with assets under management surpassing NT$70 billion. The booth also details exclusive privileges and discounts for high‑net‑worth clients.

Taiwan Business Bank centers its booth on “Craftsmanship Refined, Generations Inherited,” blending craft aesthetics with financial services to create a wealth‑management experience hall. The area is divided into four thematic zones: semiconductor, precision machinery, steel and shipping. The semiconductor zone showcases the “Fu‑Enterprise Unlimited Card” benefits; the precision‑machinery zone uses a sliding‑track installation to convey the concept of long‑term investment accumulation; the steel zone employs metal‑tempering imagery to stress risk mitigation; the shipping zone presents family‑office services and corporate succession topics. Taiwan Business Bank officially entered the Kaohsiung asset‑management zone in September and offers elegant limited‑edition gifts on site.

Changhua Bank aligns with the Asian Asset Management Center’s Kaohsiung launch with its “Changhua Bank Harbor Play” pavilion, focusing on TISA mass‑asset accumulation and high‑asset family inheritance. The “TISA Play Interactive Zone” is themed “Start from NT$1,000 – TISA Fund, Build Dreams for the Future,” featuring a dock‑style obstacle game and seminars that guide the public to set up regular TISA fund purchases via online banking. The “Asia Bay VIP Lounge” hosts family‑office asset‑planning talks and provides one‑on‑one consultations. Attendees of high‑asset or TISA seminars receive exclusive gifts.

Land Bank combines AI interaction and digital quizzes across three dedicated zones. The “ETF Investment Zone” uses AI to help visitors filter through nearly one hundred ETFs; the “TISA Account Service Zone” features a digital‑question game promoting trusts and long‑term financial planning; the “Family Office Service Zone” offers an AI‑powered photo‑simulation of high‑asset scenarios. Completing experiences in all three zones earns visitors limited‑edition premium souvenirs, and during the exhibition Land Bank runs raffles for round‑trip Tokyo tickets, Apple Watches and Dyson hair‑dryers.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybertruck將逐步停產！馬斯克押注AI轉型 背後是電動皮卡銷售困境
items.title_en: Tesla Cybertruck to be Phased Out! Musk Bets on AI Shift Amid Electric Pickup Sales Struggles
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)有時會選在微妙的時機宣布重大消息：在所有人目光放在人工智慧(AI)產業前景恐受影響、概念股深陷拋售潮之際，宣布Cybertruck電動皮卡即將逐步停產。這個走向再次凸顯出，特斯拉正進一步押注AI技術。
馬斯克周五(6日)上午在X發文說：「特斯拉將於明年年中左右，逐步停止德州超級工廠(Gigafactory Texas)的Cybertruck生產，以騰出空間提高Cybercab的產量。」
巴隆解讀，由於特斯拉僅在德州生產Cybertruck，馬斯克一席話代表這款皮卡的生產將就此告一段落。路透則指出，目前仍不清楚特斯拉會把Cybertruck移往其他工廠生產，還是真正全面停產。
馬斯克曾在2021年曾稱這款外型奇特、車身採用不鏽鋼灰色設計的大型皮卡，將是特斯拉「有史以來最好的產品」，但最終未能達到預期。
《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)報導，Cybertruck停產消息與當天股價走勢無關，但馬斯克宣布此消息的時機微妙，因為現在所有人的注意力都放在人工智慧(AI)產業發展前景。
由於民主黨在期中選舉大勝，投資人預期明年AI監管將趨嚴，特斯拉股價本周暴跌超過10%，股價短時間內從400多美元一度跌破350美元。不過該股周五隨大盤反彈，收高4.2%至每股358.22美元。

預購火爆卻賣不到10萬輛 SpaceX是大買家之一

Cybertruck於2019年11月首次亮相。特斯拉在累積數十萬筆訂單後，於2023年底開始交車，當初的大量預購訂單讓公司有信心每年可銷售25萬輛，但實際銷售並未達標。
截至今年9月，特斯拉在美國累計銷售不到10萬輛Cybertruck。這讓特斯拉學到其他電動車新創業者早已體會的教訓：預購訂單不等於實際銷量。
汽車製造商通常需要投入數十億美元開發全新車款平台，而這類平台通常每年必須銷售超過20萬輛，才能證明投資合理。Cybertruck始終未能達到這個規模，特斯拉最後選擇維持少量生產，把它定位在高價位的品牌形象車款——在汽車產業中，這類旗艦車款主要是品牌形象管理工具。
巴克萊(Barclays)分析師Dan Levy周五指出，除了提高無人自駕計程車Cybercab產量之外，Cybertruck商業表現有限、獲利率可能也有限，都是特斯拉決定讓這款皮卡退場的原因。
Cybertruck銷售高峰可能落在2024年底，當時銷量超越福特汽車(F-US)與通用汽車(GM-US)推出的其他純電動皮卡，市占率一度超過50%。但之後銷量便不再成長。
Cybertruck 2025年在美國銷售20,237輛，年減48%，而值得注意的是，馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)去年也是Cybertruck的大型買家。截至今年9月，Cybertruck銷量又年減38%。

特斯拉全力押注AI無人計程車 Cybercab接棒

特斯拉如今把重心放在靠AI訓練、沒有踏板也沒有方向盤的Cybercab。特斯拉於2025年6月在德州奧斯汀推出自駕計程車(Robotaxi)服務，但擴張速度緩慢，直到今年稍早開始把Cybercab導入Robotaxi車隊。
馬斯克正全力押注自駕技術，認為低成本無人駕駛汽車將從根本上改變個人交通運輸方式。他也相信，特斯拉擁有領先業界的自動駕駛硬體與軟體技術。
馬斯克在特斯拉第3季財報電話會議上說：「我認為，除非政府阻止我們，這當然是有可能的，例如政府試圖保護本土產業，否則我認為，只要特斯拉獲准在任何國家自由營運，最終就能承擔全球多數的乘客運輸里程。你們可以回頭檢視這項預測，但我對此深具信心。」
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk sometimes chooses delicate moments to announce major news: just as attention turns to the AI industry’s outlook and AI‑related stocks plunge, he announced that the Cybertruck electric pickup will be gradually discontinued. This move again highlights Tesla’s deeper bet on AI technology.
Musk posted on X on Friday morning (the 6th) that Tesla will begin to phase out Cybertruck production at its Gigafactory Texas around mid‑next year to free up capacity for higher Cybercab output.

Baron interprets that, since Tesla only builds the Cybertruck in Texas, Musk’s comment signals an end to the pickup’s production there. Reuters notes it remains unclear whether Tesla will shift Cybertruck production to another plant or truly cease it altogether.
Musk had said in 2021 that this uniquely styled, stainless‑steel‑gray large pickup would be Tesla’s “best product ever,” but it ultimately fell short of expectations.
Barron’s reported that the Cybertruck shutdown news is unrelated to that day’s stock movement, but the timing is delicate because everyone’s focus is on AI industry prospects.

Following a Democratic landslide in the midterms, investors expect stricter AI regulation next year; Tesla’s shares fell more than 10% this week, sliding from the $400‑plus range to briefly below $350, though the stock rebounded with the market on Friday, closing up 4.2% at $358.22.

Pre‑orders were strong but sales never reached 100,000 units, with SpaceX among the biggest buyers. The Cybertruck debuted in November 2019, and after accumulating hundreds of thousands of orders, deliveries began at the end of 2023. Initial pre‑order volumes gave the company confidence it could sell 250,000 units annually, a target it failed to meet.
By September of this year, Tesla had sold fewer than 100,000 Cybertrucks in the United States, teaching the lesson many EV startups have learned: pre‑order numbers do not equal actual sales.

Automakers typically invest billions to develop a new vehicle platform, which must sell over 200,000 units a year to justify the spend. The Cybertruck never hit that scale, so Tesla opted to keep production low, positioning it as a high‑price flagship model used mainly for brand image management.

Barclays analyst Dan Levy said on Friday that, besides boosting production of the driverless Cybercab, the limited commercial performance and modest profit margins of the Cybertruck are reasons Tesla is retiring the pickup.

The Cybertruck’s sales peak may have come at the end of 2024, when its volume briefly overtook other pure‑electric pickups from Ford (F‑US) and General Motors (GM‑US), capturing over 50% market share, after which sales stalled.

In 2025 the Cybertruck sold 20,237 units in the U.S., a 48% year‑over‑year decline, and it’s notable that Musk’s SpaceX was a major buyer last year. By September this year, sales were down another 38% year‑over‑year.

Tesla is now fully betting on the AI‑driven, pedal‑less, steering‑wheel‑free Cybercab. The company launched a robotaxi service in Austin, Texas in June 2025, but expansion has been slow, only beginning to integrate Cybercabs into the robotaxi fleet earlier this year.

Musk is doubling down on autonomous driving, believing low‑cost driverless cars will fundamentally reshape personal transportation. He also asserts that Tesla’s hardware and software for self‑driving are industry‑leading.

In the Q3 earnings call Musk said, “I think, unless governments stop us—say, by protecting domestic industries—it’s certainly possible. If Tesla is allowed to operate freely in any country, we could eventually handle the majority of global passenger‑miles. You can look back at this forecast, but I’m very confident in it.”

items.title: AI支出疑慮升高之際 Google現金流連兩季轉負 仍砸170億美元建資料中心
items.title_en: Google's Cash Flow Turns Negative for Two Quarters Amid Rising AI Spending Concerns, Yet Still Invests $17 Billion in Data Center
paras: Google加碼布局AI基礎設施,接手AI基礎設施開發商Crusoe位於美國懷俄明州東南部的一座未完工資料中心專案。Crusoe周五(6日)證實已將專案出售給Google;Google前一天(5日)宣布,將投入170億美元開發位於拉勒米縣(Laramie County)的資料中心園區,這也將成為Google在懷俄明州的首座資料中心。
根據Google官方資訊,這項計畫將建置702MW燃料電池發電設施,並搭配碳捕捉與封存(CCS)技術,燃料電池由Bloom Energy(BE-US)供應,Google並承諾負擔100%的電力成本。
不過,170億美元是Google對整體資料中心園區的開發投資規模,並非收購Crusoe專案的交易價格。Crusoe向《TechCrunch》證實出售消息,但未公布實際交易金額,目前尚無法確認Google為取得該專案支付多少費用。
《TechCrunch》報導,Crusoe去年與黑石(Blackstone)支持的基礎設施公司Tallgrass共同宣布這項開發計畫,原先規劃最終將園區電力容量擴大至10GW。Google據報在Crusoe負責管理期間,對專案成本及施工時程提出疑慮,之後決定接手開發。據《TechCrunch》轉述,這筆出售案最早由《彭博》於6月披露。
Crusoe並未因此退出與Google的合作,目前仍持續負責在德州阿馬里洛(Amarillo)附近開發另一座資料中心。
《路透社》指出,Google此時推進懷俄明州大型資料中心投資,正值美國期中選舉後,資料中心擴張面臨的政治阻力逐漸升高。《TechCrunch》指出,取得設備與電力本已不易,地方社區反對聲浪升高,可能使這類大型專案的開發更加複雜。
Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)的資本支出與現金流,也受到市場關注。Alphabet第三季資本支出達513.6億美元,低於分析師預期,自由現金流為負90.7億美元,連續第二季轉負;第二季自由現金流為負59億美元,是公司上市22年來首度轉負。
Alphabet財務長Anat Ashkenazi先前已預告,2027年資本支出將在今年預估的1950億至2050億美元基礎上「大幅增加」,顯示Alphabet仍準備進一步擴大AI及雲端基礎設施投資。
Check Capital資深投資主管Jeremy Saltsburg在《路透社》10月28日的財報報導中表示,「3000億美元的(資本支出)數字可能嚇到市場,因為自由現金流現在終於轉負」。
本周科技股重挫。周四(5日)那斯達克指數下跌5.5%,費城半導體指數重挫12%,標普500指數下跌4.4%,創2025年4月以來最大單日跌幅。高盛交易部門報告指出,這波拋售的觸發因素,是期中選舉結果出爐後,市場對資料中心建設前景的重新定價。
高盛報告並形容,AI建設的融資層面正閃爍「紅色警報」。據高盛投資人關係(IR)團隊統計,超大型科技公司今年已發行2960億美元債券,約占全球投資級債券供應總量的9%。
高盛Delta One交易部門主管Rich Privorotsky指出,AI產業當前最關鍵的問題,是未來營收能否最終匹配投入的龐大資本,目前仍沒有明確答案。
Google接手Crusoe專案並投入170億美元,正值Alphabet自由現金流轉負、資本支出持續攀升,且資料中心建設面臨地方政治阻力之際。Privorotsky認為,這波AI建設的需求、利用率與報酬,必須經受住考驗。
paras_en: Google is expanding its AI infrastructure footprint by taking over an unfinished data‑center project in southeastern Wyoming owned by AI‑infrastructure developer Crusade. Crusade confirmed on Friday (the 6th) that it has sold the project to Google; the day before (the 5th), Google announced it will invest $17 billion to develop a data‑center campus in Laramie County, which will become Google’s first data center in Wyoming.

According to Google’s official information, the plan will include a 702 MW fuel‑cell power plant equipped with carbon‑capture and storage (CCS) technology. The fuel cells will be supplied by Bloom Energy (BE‑US), and Google has pledged to cover 100% of the electricity costs.

However, the $17 billion figure refers to the total development investment for the entire data‑center campus, not the purchase price of Crusade’s project. Crusade told TechCrunch about the sale but did not disclose the actual transaction amount, so the price Google paid for the project remains unknown.

TechCrunch reported that last year Crusade, together with Blackstone‑backed infrastructure firm Tallgrass, announced the development, originally planning to eventually scale the campus’s power capacity to 10 GW. Reportedly, Google raised concerns about costs and schedule while Crusade was managing the project and then decided to take over development. The sale was first reported by Bloomberg in June, according to TechCrunch.
Crusade has not withdrawn from its partnership with Google and continues to work on another data‑center near Amarillo, Texas.

Reuters noted that Google’s push for a large data‑center in Wyoming comes as political resistance to data‑center expansion in the United States is rising after the mid‑term elections. TechCrunch added that securing equipment and power is already difficult, and growing local opposition could make such large projects even more complex.

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Google’s parent, is seeing its capital expenditures and cash flow closely watched. Alphabet’s Q3 capex was $51.36 billion, below analysts’ expectations, and free cash flow turned negative at $9.07 billion, marking the second consecutive quarter of negative cash flow; Q2 free cash flow was negative $5.9 billion, the first quarterly deficit in the company’s 22‑year public history.

Chief Financial Officer Anat Ashkenazi has previously warned that 2027 capital spending will “significantly increase” from the current year’s forecast of $195‑$205 billion, indicating Alphabet’s intent to further expand AI and cloud infrastructure investments.
Check Capital senior investment officer Jeremy Saltsburg told Reuters on Oct. 28 that “a $300 billion capex number could scare the market, because free cash flow is finally turning negative.”

Technology stocks slumped this week. On Thursday (the 5th) the Nasdaq fell 5.5%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 12%, and the S&P 500 slid 4.4%, the biggest single‑day decline since April 2025. A Goldman Sachs trading desk report said the sell‑off was triggered by the mid‑term election results, which prompted a re‑pricing of data‑center construction outlooks.

The Goldman report described financing for AI build‑outs as flashing a “red alert.” According to the firm’s investor‑relations team, mega‑tech companies have issued $296 billion in bonds this year, about 9% of global investment‑grade bond supply.

Goldman’s Delta One head Rich Privorotsky said the most critical issue for the AI industry now is whether future revenues will ultimately match the massive capital being poured in, and there is still no clear answer.

Google’s takeover of Crusade’s project and its $17 billion investment come as Alphabet’s free cash flow turns negative, capex keeps climbing, and data‑center construction faces local political resistance. Privorotsky believes the demand, utilization and returns of this AI build‑out must stand the test of time.

items.title: Google斥資170億美元布局AI！收購Crusoe懷俄明州資料中心基地
items.title_en: Google to Spend $17 Billion on AI Infrastructure, Acquires Crusoe's Wyoming Data Center Site
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎設施開發商 Crusoe 周五（6日）表示，Google(GOOGL-US) 已收購該公司位於美國懷俄明州東南部的資料中心基地。就在前一天，Google 母公司 Alphabet宣布將斥資170億美元投資該專案。
根據《路透》報導，Alphabet周四（5日）宣布，將在懷俄明州興建旗下首座資料中心，進一步擴大AI基礎設施布局，儘管美國部分地區對此類專案的政治反對聲浪日益升高。
Crusoe指出，公司已完成該專案前期開發階段的參與工作，內容包括基地選址、取得政府核准，以及電力供應策略規劃。
這座資料中心園區最初由Crusoe與Tallgrass Energy共同開發，雙方此次交易的財務條件並未對外公布。
Google周四表示，將與Tallgrass Energy、Black Hills Energy、美國電力公司（American Electric Power）及Related Digital合作興建這座資料中心。
Crusoe執行長洛克米勒（Chase Lochmiller）表示，公司目前已簽約的電力容量超過6GW，另有逾40GW的開發案正在規劃中。
此外，Crusoe也透露，目前正為Google開發另一座資料中心園區，地點位於阿肯色州阿姆斯特朗（Armstrong），該計畫已於今年稍早對外公布。
paras_en: AI infrastructure developer Crusoe said on Friday (the 6th) that Google (GOOGL-US) has acquired the company's data center site in southeastern Wyoming, and that the day before, Google's parent Alphabet announced a $17 billion investment in the project.

According to Reuters, Alphabet announced on Thursday (the 5th) that it will build its first data center in Wyoming to further expand its AI infrastructure footprint, despite growing political opposition to such projects in parts of the United States.
Crusoe noted that it has completed the early‑stage development work for the project, including site selection, obtaining government approvals, and planning the power‑supply strategy.
The data center campus was originally co‑developed by Crusoe and Tallgrass Energy, and the financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Google said on Thursday that it will partner with Tallgrass Energy, Black Hills Energy, American Electric Power, and Related Digital to build the data center.
Crusoe CEO Chase Lochmiller said the company has already contracted more than 6 GW of power capacity, with over 40 GW of additional projects currently in planning.
Crusoe also disclosed that it is developing another data center campus for Google in Armstrong, Arkansas, a project that was announced earlier this year.

items.title: 美股震盪還沒完？VIX維持高檔 銅價成AI行情關鍵指標
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Still Turbulent? VIX Stays Elevated as Copper Prices Become Key AI Indicator
paras: 美國科技股遭遇猛烈拋售後，週五 (6 日) 迎來反彈，但華爾街「恐慌指數」VIX 仍明顯高於選後低點，顯示市場對短期震盪的戒心尚未消退。部分策略師也建議關注銅價，透過這項人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設重要原料的走勢，輔助判斷投資人是否過度反映 AI 建設放緩的風險。
《巴隆週刊》週五報導，美國期中選舉帶來的政治變局，正促使投資人重新評估 AI 投資前景。民主黨大勝後，市場最初關注美伊戰爭可能走向終結，隨後焦點迅速轉向部分民主黨人士反對資料中心擴建，以及相關政策可能對 AI 基礎建設投資造成的限制。
這項預期轉變引爆科技股賣壓。那斯達克綜合指數週四 (5 日) 重挫逾 1,400 點，跌幅達 5.52%；費城半導體指數下跌 12.25%，截至當日收盤，較 6 月歷史高點累計回落近 40%。
科技股週五出現逢低買盤，那斯達克綜合指數上漲 1.09%，收在 24,579.42 點；費城半導體指數勁揚 4.21%，收在 9,390.25 點。不過，單日回升仍未彌補前一交易日的猛烈跌勢。
VIX回落仍處高檔 市場震盪疑慮未退
芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數 (VIX) 週四飆升 69.66%，收在 28.18 點；週五雖回落 9.01%，收在 25.64 點，仍明顯高於週三的 16.61 點，反映市場波動預期尚未回到選後低點。
VIX 根據標普 500 指數選擇權價格計算，衡量市場對未來 30 天波動的預期。指數升高代表投資人預期行情震盪加劇，但不預測股市漲跌方向，也不代表每天必然出現特定幅度的波動。
凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 市場經濟學家 Joe Maher 表示，美國政治版圖出現重大變化，使投資人更加擔心 AI 建設熱潮能否持續，導致科技股再度遭遇沉重打擊。
他認為，期中選舉帶來的衝擊是否會成為終結 AI 股市榮景的催化劑，目前仍有待觀察，但這已強化該機構對這波行情進入後期階段的判斷。
費半反彈仍低於200日線 技術面尚待修復
除了波動預期升高，美股技術面也受到明顯破壞。費城半導體指數週五雖強勁反彈，仍低於約 10,831 點的 200 日移動平均線，與這項長期趨勢指標相距約 13.3%。
LPL Financial 首席跨資產策略師 Adam Turnquist 指出，VIX 急升反映市場情緒迅速轉變。不過，儘管週四跌勢猛烈，波動率尚未達到歷史上常見於投資人全面認賠出場時的極端水準。
這意味著，恐慌升溫本身還不足以確認賣壓已經出清，也不能據此判定股市即將落底。
銅價測試200日線 AI需求疑慮仍待觀察
在股市之外，Turnquist 建議關注銅價走勢。銅是資料中心及 AI 基礎建設的重要投入原料，其價格可作為觀察相關投資前景的輔助訊號。
他認為，相較於 AI 類股急跌，銅價的技術面表現可能暗示，股票市場已過度反映需求放緩的風險；若銅價後續跌破支撐，則會讓 AI 建設放緩的論述更具說服力。
不過，週五銅市走勢也顯示，這項支撐正面臨考驗。
倫敦金屬交易所 (LME) 三個月期銅當天盤中一度跌至每公噸 13,636 美元，創 7 月 30 日以來最低，隨後在 200 日移動平均線附近獲得支撐。依 LME 公布數據，週五收盤價為每公噸 13,768 美元。
銅價獲得支撐，仍不足以證明 AI 需求無虞或相關股票已經落底。
礦山供應挑戰及美國以外地區的金屬供應緊張，也限制了銅價跌勢，因此其表現不能完全歸因於需求。
對投資人而言，VIX 能否持續回落，以及銅價能否守住長期支撐，將是後續值得追蹤的訊號。前者反映市場對股市波動的預期，後者則提供另一個觀察 AI 投資疑慮是否擴散至原物料市場的角度。
paras_en: After a sharp sell‑off in U.S. tech stocks, Friday (the 6th) saw a rebound, but the Wall Street "fear gauge" VIX remained well above its post‑election low, indicating that market wariness of short‑term volatility has not faded. Some strategists also suggest watching copper prices, using the trend of this essential AI‑infrastructure material to gauge whether investors are over‑reacting to a slowdown in AI construction risk.

Baron Weekly reported on Friday that the political shift caused by the U.S. midterm elections is prompting investors to reassess AI investment prospects. After the Democrats’ big win, the market initially focused on a possible end to the U.S.–Iran conflict, then quickly turned to opposition from some Democrats to data‑center expansion and the potential policy constraints such opposition could place on AI infrastructure spending.

This expected shift sparked selling pressure on tech stocks. The Nasdaq Composite plunged more than 1,400 points on Thursday (the 5th), down 5.52%; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.25%, leaving it nearly 40% below its June historical high at the close.

Tech stocks found buying on the dip on Friday, with the Nasdaq up 1.09% to 24,579.42 points and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rallying 4.21% to 9,390.25 points. However, the single‑day rebound did not erase the heavy losses from the previous session.
VIX Pulls Back Yet Remains High; Market‑Oscillation Concerns Persist

The Chicago Board Options Exchange volatility index (VIX) surged 69.66% on Thursday to 28.18 points; it fell 9.01% on Friday to 25.64 points, still markedly above Wednesday’s 16.61 points, reflecting that expectations of market swings have not returned to post‑election lows.

The VIX, calculated from S&P 500 index option prices, measures expected 30‑day market volatility. A higher index signals investors anticipate more pronounced market swings, but it does not predict the direction of stock moves nor guarantee a specific daily volatility range.

Capital Economics market economist Joe Maher said the major shift in the U.S. political landscape is making investors more nervous about whether the AI construction boom can be sustained, leading to another heavy hit on tech stocks.

He added that whether the midterm shock will become a catalyst that ends the AI‑stock rally remains to be seen, but it has reinforced the firm’s view that the current rally is entering its later stage.
Semiconductor Index Rebound Still Below 200‑Day Moving Average; Technicals Need Repair

Beyond higher volatility expectations, U.S. equity technicals have also taken a clear hit. Although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rebounded strongly on Friday, it stayed below its 200‑day moving average of roughly 10,831 points, about 13.3% under that long‑term trend line.

LPL Financial chief cross‑asset strategist Adam Turnquist noted that the sharp VIX rise reflects a rapid shift in market sentiment. Yet, despite Thursday’s brutal drop, volatility has not reached the extreme levels historically seen when investors fully capitulate and exit positions.
This means that rising panic alone is insufficient to confirm that selling pressure has been fully exhausted, nor does it prove the market is about to bottom.
Copper Prices Test 200‑Day Line; AI‑Demand Concerns Remain Unclear

Outside the equity market, Turnquist recommends watching copper price movements. Copper is a key input for data centers and AI infrastructure, and its price can serve as a supplementary signal for assessing related investment outlooks.

He believes that, compared with the sharp fall in AI‑related stocks, copper’s technical performance may suggest the equity market has over‑reacted to the risk of slowing demand; if copper later breaks its support, the narrative of a slowdown in AI construction would gain more credibility.
However, Friday’s copper market also showed that this support is under pressure.

The London Metal Exchange three‑month copper contract fell intraday to $13,636 per metric ton, the lowest since July 30, before finding support near the 200‑day moving average. According to LME data, Friday’s closing price was $13,768 per metric ton.
While copper has found support, it is not enough to prove that AI demand is safe or that related stocks have bottomed.
Mining supply challenges and tight metal supplies outside the United States also limit copper’s decline, so its performance cannot be attributed solely to demand factors.

For investors, whether the VIX continues to fall and whether copper can hold its long‑term support will be key signals to watch. The former reflects market expectations of stock‑market volatility, while the latter offers another angle to gauge whether AI‑investment concerns are spilling over into the commodities market.

items.title: 美國期中選舉民主黨大勝、金管會祭出限空令、永豐銀行爆資安事件 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Midterm US Election Lands Democrats a Big Win, Financial Supervisory Commission Issues Short‑Selling Ban, and Yongfeng Bank Suffers Cyber‑Security Incident – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨大勝，民主黨橫掃參眾兩院；台股周五(6日)盤中狂瀉近3800點，國安基金下周起護盤，金管會也祭出限空令；永豐銀行周二(3日)發生異常轉帳事件，確定為外部駭客利用「新網銀交易系統」之供應商安全設定漏洞所致，以下為本周大事回顧：

美國國會變天 台灣會受什麼影響？分析師點出兩大焦點 

美國期中選舉民主黨拿下國會兩院多數後，台灣將受到哪些影響？分析師指出，台海局勢與美中科技競爭是兩大觀察焦點。民主黨主導的國會可能透過立法、聽證會及挺台行動，推動更強硬的對中政策，增加川普維持美中關係穩定的難度；台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)在人工智慧(AI)晶片供應鏈的關鍵地位，也讓台灣成為科技角力的重要一環。

金管會祭三招救市 調降借券賣出額度、調高融券保證金成數、放寬多元擔保品 

繼國安基金宣布決議進場執行護盤任務後，金管會周五 (6日) 晚間亦祭出限空令，證期局宣布，自9日起調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，同步調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。

〈永豐資安事件〉「金錢無損但商譽受創」 已下架新網銀系統並將向國外供應商求償 

針對周二(3日)發生的異常轉帳事件，永豐銀行周三(4日)晚間召開記者會，經調查，確定為外部駭客利用「新網銀交易系統」之供應商安全設定漏洞所致。永豐銀行董事長曹為實與總經理莊銘福親上火線，向受影響客戶及社會大眾鞠躬致歉，並直言「此案雖無損失，但商譽影響甚鉅」。目前永豐銀已將該系統全面下架，並正籌備相關事證，準備向該國外軟體供應商進行法律求償。

台股下周「安」了！國安基金緊急召開臨時會 拍板進場護盤 

台股周五(6日)演出史上最大崩跌，重跌近3800點，連續五日收黑，上午行政院長卓榮泰緊急呼籲金管會採取因應措施後，國安基金於下午2點30分召開第131次臨時委員會議。經管理委員會充分討論並達成共識決議，正式授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，宣告下周起將發揮護盤救市功效，全力維持資本市場穩定。

AI股驚魂洗盤！重挫1873點創史上第4大 年線失而復得 

受美股昨夜重挫影響，亞洲股市開盤集體受挫，韓股早盤更觸發熔斷。台股周五(6日)開盤即面臨強烈拋售壓力，開盤跳空摜破 4 萬點大關及年線支撐，盤中最低下探 37,837.05 點，暴跌 3,737.67 點，刷新歷史盤中最大跌點紀錄。隨後在行政院緊急宣示穩市決心下，低接買盤進場，帶動指數高低震盪近 2,600 點。終場加權指數下跌 1,873.08 點(跌幅 4.51%)，收在 39,701.64 點，雖失守四萬點關卡，但已大幅收斂失地，創下史上第 4 大收盤跌點，總成交值擴大至 1 兆 2,461.04 億元。

大同華映案和解露曙光 有望回沖近百億元損失 估每股稅前盈餘貢獻4.6元 

大同(2371-TW)纏訟多年的中國華映案露和解曙光，公司周一(2日)召開重訊記者會，指出雙方歷經協商並各自召開董事會，決議通過以人民幣7.68億元(約新台幣37.56億元)的和解金條件為目標，若後續簽署和解文件，有望回沖近百億元的損失，每股稅前盈餘有望貢獻4.6元。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the US midterm elections, and Taiwan’s stock market plunged nearly 3,800 points on Friday (the 6th). The National Security Fund will start market‑stabilizing purchases next week, and the Financial Supervisory Commission has also issued a short‑selling restriction. Yongfeng Bank experienced an abnormal transfer incident on Tuesday (the 3rd), confirmed to be caused by an external hacker exploiting a security‑setting flaw in the supplier of its new online banking system. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

What impact will the US congressional shift have on Taiwan? Analysts point to two key focuses. After the Democrats secured majorities in both chambers, they may pursue tougher China policies through legislation, hearings and pro‑Taiwan actions, making it harder for a Trump‑style approach to maintain stable US‑China relations. Meanwhile, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) remains a pivotal player in the AI chip supply chain, positioning Taiwan at the heart of the tech rivalry.

The Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out three market‑stabilizing measures: lowering the daily borrowing‑sell limit, raising the margin‑requirement ratio for securities lending, and relaxing the range of eligible collateral. Following the National Security Fund’s decision to intervene, the commission announced a short‑selling ban on Friday evening. Starting September 9, the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order cap will be reduced while the margin‑requirement ratio will be increased, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling and expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, thereby safeguarding market stability.

Yongfeng Bank’s cyber‑security incident – “No monetary loss but reputational damage” – led the bank to pull the new online banking system and seek compensation from the foreign supplier. After the abnormal transfer on Tuesday (the 3rd), the bank held a press conference on Wednesday night (the 4th). An investigation confirmed that external hackers exploited a security‑setting vulnerability in the supplier’s new online banking platform. Chairman Cao Weishi and CEO Zhuang Mingfu personally apologized to affected customers and the public, stating that while no funds were lost, the incident severely harmed the bank’s reputation. The system has been fully taken offline, and the bank is preparing evidence to pursue legal claims against the overseas software vendor.

The Taiwan stock market will be “secured” next week as the National Security Fund convened an emergency meeting and approved market‑stabilizing purchases. Friday (the 6th) saw the market’s biggest one‑day drop in history, falling nearly 3,800 points and posting five consecutive days of losses. After Premier Zhuo Rong‑tai urgently called on the Financial Supervisory Commission to act, the fund held its 131st emergency committee meeting at 2:30 p.m., where the management board reached consensus to authorize the secretariat to deploy funds as needed for market stabilization, announcing that the fund will begin its protective role next week to maintain market order.

AI‑related stocks were hit hard in a sharp sell‑off, plunging 1,873 points – the fourth‑largest daily drop on record – before the annual trend line was briefly reclaimed. Influenced by a steep decline in US equities overnight, Asian markets opened lower, with South Korean stocks triggering circuit breakers. Taiwan’s index opened with strong selling pressure, breaking the 40,000‑point psychological barrier and the annual trend line, sinking to a intraday low of 37,837.05 points, a drop of 3,737.67 points and a new record for the largest intraday fall. After the cabinet’s emergency market‑stability pledge, buying pressure helped the index swing within a 2,600‑point range, closing down 1,873.08 points (‑4.51%) at 39,701.64 points. Although the 40,000‑point level was lost, the decline narrowed sharply, marking the fourth‑largest closing drop ever, with total turnover rising to NT$1.246104 trillion.

The long‑running Da‑Tong–China Huaying dispute shows signs of resolution, with a potential recovery of nearly NT$10 billion in losses and an estimated pre‑tax earnings contribution of NT$4.6 per share. Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) announced on Monday (the 2nd) that after extensive negotiations and board approvals, both parties aim to settle with a settlement amount of RMB 7.68 billion (approximately NT$37.56 billion). If the settlement agreement is signed, the company could recoup close to NT$10 billion in losses, contributing about NT$4.6 per share to pre‑tax earnings.

items.title: 〈華邦電展望〉晶圓龍頭傳跨足3D DRAM 焦佑鈞：台積追求卓越 不會做半調子
items.title_en: <Wah Boon Electronics Outlook> Wafer Leader Rumored to Enter 3D DRAM; Jiao Youjun: TSMC Pursues Excellence and Won’t Do Half‑Measures
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(7)日舉辦 2026 年度家庭日，晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)近期傳出有意為輝達(NVIDIA)生產 3D DRAM，藉此進軍先進記憶體領域，引發半導體供應鏈高度關注。記憶體大廠華邦電董事長焦佑鈞受訪時指出，台積電是一家追求卓越的公司，若真有規劃跨足 DRAM 市場，絕不可能做半吊子，必定會在技術完全成熟前選擇默默進行，不會輕易釋出未準備好的訊息。
焦佑鈞分析，晶圓代工大廠若要跨入 DRAM 領域，首要面臨的正是技術自主與龐大的專利壁壘。DRAM 技術無法憑空而來，企業必須審慎評估是否願意投入鉅額資金進行自主研發，同時還需處理極為複雜的記憶體專利。
此外，台積電目前與三星、華邦電等各大記憶體廠在先進封裝領域均保持緊密的合作關係，在既有生態系合作良好的基礎下，自行跳下來跨界開發 DRAM 產品的可能性並不高。
針對 AI 資料中心資本支出議題，焦佑鈞指出，台積電與整體供應鏈在 2027 至 2028 年的裝機需求極為確定，雲端服務業者(CSP)的前期投資與設備均已到位。
然而，若總體經濟資金限制逐漸顯現，2029 年半導體產業恐迎來下一波景氣調整，屆時先進封裝與記憶體供應鏈的產能配比將成為市場觀察重點。
paras_en: Wah Boon Electronics (2344‑TW) held its 2026 Family Day today (the 7th). Recently, wafer‑foundry giant TSMC (2330‑TW) is rumored to be interested in producing 3D DRAM for NVIDIA, aiming to break into the advanced memory market, which has drawn intense attention across the semiconductor supply chain. In an interview, Wah Boon’s chairman Jiao Youjun said TSMC is a company that strives for excellence; if it truly plans to step into the DRAM market, it would never do a half‑hearted job and would keep any activity under wraps until the technology is fully mature, avoiding the release of unprepared information.

Jiao explained that for a major foundry to enter the DRAM field, the primary challenges are technological independence and massive patent barriers. DRAM technology cannot be invented out of thin air; a company must carefully assess whether it is willing to invest huge sums in independent R&D while also navigating an extremely complex web of memory patents.

Moreover, TSMC already maintains close collaborations with leading memory makers such as Samsung and Wah Boon in the advanced packaging arena. Given the strong existing ecosystem partnerships, the likelihood of TSMC abruptly jumping into DRAM product development on its own is low.

Addressing AI data‑center capital‑expenditure issues, Jiao noted that TSMC and the broader supply chain have a very clear outlook for equipment demand in 2027‑2028, with cloud service providers (CSPs) already having made their upfront investments and secured the necessary equipment.

However, if overall economic financing constraints become more pronounced, the semiconductor industry could face its next cyclical adjustment in 2029. At that point, the capacity balance between advanced packaging and memory supply chains will become a key focus for the market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉華航客貨運業績暢旺 股價創3個月來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: China Airlines' Passenger and Cargo Operations Thrive, Stock Hits 3-Month High
paras: 華航(2610-TW)第三季暑期客運業績暢旺，第四季又迎來貨運傳統旺季，同時國際油價有望回跌，使本周股價在台股大回檔之際，相對有撐，周漲逾5%，最高來到22.15元創8月以來新高價位。
華航第三季稅後純益44.2億元，年增49.56%，每股純益(EPS)0.72元，創單季第三高紀錄，而前三季稅後純益110.02億元，年增0.05%，EPS 1.8元，儘管面臨高油價，仍有效穩住獲利動能。
展望第四季，華航看好，空運迎來旺季，可望帶動傳產、電商等其他空運主力產品拉貨潮，預估可支撐整體貨運需求續強。
法人分析，明年AI 產業將持續帶動電子產品空運需求，而華航預計新增 4 架 777-F 貨機，空運成長動能可期。
另一方面，在中東戰爭影響逐漸降低下，法人預估明年航空燃油均價將小幅低於今年，有助航空業獲利處成長趨勢。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610-TW) saw strong passenger performance in Q3 summer, and Q4 welcomes the traditional cargo peak season, while international oil prices are expected to fall, giving its stock relative support during a broad market pullback; the stock rose over 5% for the week, reaching a high of NT$22.15, a new peak since August.

China Airlines posted Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$4.42 billion, up 49.56% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.72, the third‑quarter highest on record, while net profit for the first three quarters was NT$11.002 billion, up 0.05% YoY, EPS NT$1.80; despite high fuel costs, it effectively maintained profit momentum.

Looking ahead to Q4, the airline is optimistic; air freight enters its peak season and is expected to drive a cargo surge from traditional manufacturers, e‑commerce and other major air‑freight shippers, supporting continued strong overall cargo demand.

Institutional analysts note that the AI industry will continue to boost demand for air transport of electronic products next year, and China Airlines plans to add four 777‑F freighters, giving its cargo growth momentum.

Meanwhile, as the impact of the Middle East war gradually diminishes, analysts forecast that average jet fuel prices next year will be slightly lower than this year, helping the airline industry's profit growth trend.

items.title_en: Win a Tokyo Flight Ticket at the Kaohsiung Financial Expo! State-Owned Banks Enter the High-Asset Zone with Exclusive Offers
paras: 2026高雄國際金融博覽會11月6至8日高雄展覽館登場，集合國內外金融機構，以ETF投資、TISA帳戶及家族辦公室為三大主軸。公股銀行攜手進駐亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區，兆豐金控 （2886-TW）、第一銀行、臺灣企銀 (2834-TW）、彰化銀行（2801-TW）與土地銀行分別以超跑賽事、港灣意象、工藝美學與AI互動打造沉浸式展區，土銀更祭出抽獎東京來回機票及Apple Watch等活動，搶攻普惠金融與高端財富管理商機。

兆豐金控今年以「兆豐財富超跑賽」為主題，集結兆豐銀行、兆豐投信、兆豐證券及兆豐期貨四大事業體。現場展示機器人理財「理財e把兆」、美股盤前交易與每股GO服務、兆期Pro策略交易平台及四大ETF投資主題，並設計「ETF神配對」等互動遊戲與電子集章闖關。兆豐銀行機器人理財結合晨星（Morningstar）專業機制，基金最低新台幣2000元、ETF最低3000元即可投資；兆豐證券美股GO享手續費均一價且無低收門檻。民眾集滿4個電子章可兌換限定好禮，體驗機器人理財還可享用冰沙。
第一銀行首度以「高資產業務」為核心參展，打造「第一領航・豐盈之境」主題展區。視覺呼應高雄亞灣港灣意象，展示財管2.0高資產業務開辦5年成果、高雄專區業務及家族辦公室服務。第一銀行身為首批進駐高雄專區的銀行之一，專區客戶數已突破500戶，資產管理規模衝上700億元大關。現場亦詳細介紹高資產客戶專屬尊榮權益與優惠。
臺灣企銀以「匠心淬鍊，世代傳承」為核心，將工藝美學結合金融服務打造財富管理體驗館。展區規劃半導體、精密機械、鋼鐵及航運四大主題區。半導體區展示福企無限卡權益；精密機械區透過滑軌裝置傳遞長期投資累積理念；鋼鐵區以金屬淬鍊意象強調風險預防；航運區則展示家族辦公室服務與企業接班議題。台灣企銀今年9月已正式進駐高雄資產管理專區，展區現場提供精美限量好禮。
彰化銀行呼應亞洲資產管理中心落地高雄，以「彰銀泊樂港」主題館參展，聚焦TISA全民資產累積與高資產家族傳承。「TISA泊樂互動區」以「從1000元開始，TISA基金・築夢未來」為主題，推出碼頭闖關遊戲與講座，引導民眾透過網路銀行辦理TISA基金定期定額。「亞灣海境貴賓室」則舉辦家族辦公室資產規劃講座並提供一對一諮詢。參加高資產或TISA講座均可獲得專屬禮品。
土地銀行結合AI互動與數位問答打造三大專區。「ETF投資專區」導入AI互動協助民眾篩選近百檔ETF；「TISA帳戶服務區」設數位問答遊戲宣導信託與長期理財；「家族辦公室服務區」則提供AI拍照體驗模擬高資產情境。完成三大專區體驗可獲贈限量精美贈品，展覽期間更提供東京來回機票、Apple Watch及Dyson吹風機等抽獎活動。

paras_en: The 2026 Kaohsiung International Financial Expo will be held from November 6 to 8 at the Kaohsiung Exhibition Center, gathering domestic and overseas financial institutions around three main themes: ETF investing, TISA accounts, and family offices. State-owned banks are joining the Asian Asset Management Center's Kaohsiung zone, with Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), First Bank, Taiwan Business Bank (2834‑TW), Changhua Bank (2801‑TW) and Land Bank each creating immersive booths featuring super‑car races, harbor imagery, craft aesthetics and AI interaction. Land Bank is also offering a raffle for round‑trip Tokyo airfare and Apple Watches, targeting both inclusive finance and high‑end wealth‑management opportunities.

Mega Financial Holding’s theme this year is the “Mega Wealth Super‑Car Race,” bringing together its four core businesses: Mega Bank, Mega Investment Trust, Mega Securities and Mega Futures. The booth showcases the robot‑advisor “Wealth e‑Ba,” pre‑market U.S. stock trading with per‑share GO service, the Mega Futures Pro strategy platform, and four ETF investment themes, plus interactive games such as “ETF Match‑Making” and electronic stamp challenges. Mega Bank’s robot‑advisor integrates Morningstar’s professional methodology, allowing investments as low as NT$2,000 for funds and NT$3,000 for ETFs; Mega Securities’ U.S. stock GO service offers a flat commission with no minimum purchase. Visitors who collect four electronic stamps can redeem limited‑edition gifts, and those who try the robot‑advisor receive a complimentary smoothie.

First Bank is participating for the first time with a “High‑Asset Business” focus, creating the “First Navigation – Realm of Abundance” exhibition area. Visuals echo Kaohsiung’s Asia Bay harbor motif and display the results of its Wealth Management 2.0 high‑asset services over five years, as well as Kaohsiung‑zone offerings and family‑office services. As one of the first banks to enter the Kaohsiung zone, First Bank now serves over 500 zone clients, with assets under management surpassing NT$70 billion. The booth also details exclusive privileges and discounts for high‑net‑worth clients.

Taiwan Business Bank centers its booth on “Craftsmanship Refined, Generations Inherited,” blending craft aesthetics with financial services to create a wealth‑management experience hall. The area is divided into four thematic zones: semiconductor, precision machinery, steel and shipping. The semiconductor zone showcases the “Fu‑Enterprise Unlimited Card” benefits; the precision‑machinery zone uses a sliding‑track installation to convey the concept of long‑term investment accumulation; the steel zone employs metal‑tempering imagery to stress risk mitigation; the shipping zone presents family‑office services and corporate succession topics. Taiwan Business Bank officially entered the Kaohsiung asset‑management zone in September and offers elegant limited‑edition gifts on site.

Changhua Bank aligns with the Asian Asset Management Center’s Kaohsiung launch with its “Changhua Bank Harbor Play” pavilion, focusing on TISA mass‑asset accumulation and high‑asset family inheritance. The “TISA Play Interactive Zone” is themed “Start from NT$1,000 – TISA Fund, Build Dreams for the Future,” featuring a dock‑style obstacle game and seminars that guide the public to set up regular TISA fund purchases via online banking. The “Asia Bay VIP Lounge” hosts family‑office asset‑planning talks and provides one‑on‑one consultations. Attendees of high‑asset or TISA seminars receive exclusive gifts.

Land Bank combines AI interaction and digital quizzes across three dedicated zones. The “ETF Investment Zone” uses AI to help visitors filter through nearly one hundred ETFs; the “TISA Account Service Zone” features a digital‑question game promoting trusts and long‑term financial planning; the “Family Office Service Zone” offers an AI‑powered photo‑simulation of high‑asset scenarios. Completing experiences in all three zones earns visitors limited‑edition premium souvenirs, and during the exhibition Land Bank runs raffles for round‑trip Tokyo tickets, Apple Watches and Dyson hair‑dryers.

items.title: 美國期中選舉民主黨大勝、金管會祭出限空令、永豐銀行爆資安事件 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Midterm US Election Lands Democrats a Big Win, Financial Supervisory Commission Issues Short‑Selling Ban, and Yongfeng Bank Suffers Cyber‑Security Incident – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨大勝，民主黨橫掃參眾兩院；台股周五(6日)盤中狂瀉近3800點，國安基金下周起護盤，金管會也祭出限空令；永豐銀行周二(3日)發生異常轉帳事件，確定為外部駭客利用「新網銀交易系統」之供應商安全設定漏洞所致，以下為本周大事回顧：

美國國會變天 台灣會受什麼影響？分析師點出兩大焦點 

美國期中選舉民主黨拿下國會兩院多數後，台灣將受到哪些影響？分析師指出，台海局勢與美中科技競爭是兩大觀察焦點。民主黨主導的國會可能透過立法、聽證會及挺台行動，推動更強硬的對中政策，增加川普維持美中關係穩定的難度；台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)在人工智慧(AI)晶片供應鏈的關鍵地位，也讓台灣成為科技角力的重要一環。

金管會祭三招救市 調降借券賣出額度、調高融券保證金成數、放寬多元擔保品 

繼國安基金宣布決議進場執行護盤任務後，金管會周五 (6日) 晚間亦祭出限空令，證期局宣布，自9日起調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，同步調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。

〈永豐資安事件〉「金錢無損但商譽受創」 已下架新網銀系統並將向國外供應商求償 

針對周二(3日)發生的異常轉帳事件，永豐銀行周三(4日)晚間召開記者會，經調查，確定為外部駭客利用「新網銀交易系統」之供應商安全設定漏洞所致。永豐銀行董事長曹為實與總經理莊銘福親上火線，向受影響客戶及社會大眾鞠躬致歉，並直言「此案雖無損失，但商譽影響甚鉅」。目前永豐銀已將該系統全面下架，並正籌備相關事證，準備向該國外軟體供應商進行法律求償。

台股下周「安」了！國安基金緊急召開臨時會 拍板進場護盤 

台股周五(6日)演出史上最大崩跌，重跌近3800點，連續五日收黑，上午行政院長卓榮泰緊急呼籲金管會採取因應措施後，國安基金於下午2點30分召開第131次臨時委員會議。經管理委員會充分討論並達成共識決議，正式授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，宣告下周起將發揮護盤救市功效，全力維持資本市場穩定。

AI股驚魂洗盤！重挫1873點創史上第4大 年線失而復得 

受美股昨夜重挫影響，亞洲股市開盤集體受挫，韓股早盤更觸發熔斷。台股周五(6日)開盤即面臨強烈拋售壓力，開盤跳空摜破 4 萬點大關及年線支撐，盤中最低下探 37,837.05 點，暴跌 3,737.67 點，刷新歷史盤中最大跌點紀錄。隨後在行政院緊急宣示穩市決心下，低接買盤進場，帶動指數高低震盪近 2,600 點。終場加權指數下跌 1,873.08 點(跌幅 4.51%)，收在 39,701.64 點，雖失守四萬點關卡，但已大幅收斂失地，創下史上第 4 大收盤跌點，總成交值擴大至 1 兆 2,461.04 億元。

大同華映案和解露曙光 有望回沖近百億元損失 估每股稅前盈餘貢獻4.6元 

大同(2371-TW)纏訟多年的中國華映案露和解曙光，公司周一(2日)召開重訊記者會，指出雙方歷經協商並各自召開董事會，決議通過以人民幣7.68億元(約新台幣37.56億元)的和解金條件為目標，若後續簽署和解文件，有望回沖近百億元的損失，每股稅前盈餘有望貢獻4.6元。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the US midterm elections, and Taiwan’s stock market plunged nearly 3,800 points on Friday (the 6th). The National Security Fund will start market‑stabilizing purchases next week, and the Financial Supervisory Commission has also issued a short‑selling restriction. Yongfeng Bank experienced an abnormal transfer incident on Tuesday (the 3rd), confirmed to be caused by an external hacker exploiting a security‑setting flaw in the supplier of its new online banking system. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

What impact will the US congressional shift have on Taiwan? Analysts point to two key focuses. After the Democrats secured majorities in both chambers, they may pursue tougher China policies through legislation, hearings and pro‑Taiwan actions, making it harder for a Trump‑style approach to maintain stable US‑China relations. Meanwhile, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) remains a pivotal player in the AI chip supply chain, positioning Taiwan at the heart of the tech rivalry.

The Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out three market‑stabilizing measures: lowering the daily borrowing‑sell limit, raising the margin‑requirement ratio for securities lending, and relaxing the range of eligible collateral. Following the National Security Fund’s decision to intervene, the commission announced a short‑selling ban on Friday evening. Starting September 9, the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order cap will be reduced while the margin‑requirement ratio will be increased, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling and expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, thereby safeguarding market stability.

Yongfeng Bank’s cyber‑security incident – “No monetary loss but reputational damage” – led the bank to pull the new online banking system and seek compensation from the foreign supplier. After the abnormal transfer on Tuesday (the 3rd), the bank held a press conference on Wednesday night (the 4th). An investigation confirmed that external hackers exploited a security‑setting vulnerability in the supplier’s new online banking platform. Chairman Cao Weishi and CEO Zhuang Mingfu personally apologized to affected customers and the public, stating that while no funds were lost, the incident severely harmed the bank’s reputation. The system has been fully taken offline, and the bank is preparing evidence to pursue legal claims against the overseas software vendor.

The Taiwan stock market will be “secured” next week as the National Security Fund convened an emergency meeting and approved market‑stabilizing purchases. Friday (the 6th) saw the market’s biggest one‑day drop in history, falling nearly 3,800 points and posting five consecutive days of losses. After Premier Zhuo Rong‑tai urgently called on the Financial Supervisory Commission to act, the fund held its 131st emergency committee meeting at 2:30 p.m., where the management board reached consensus to authorize the secretariat to deploy funds as needed for market stabilization, announcing that the fund will begin its protective role next week to maintain market order.

AI‑related stocks were hit hard in a sharp sell‑off, plunging 1,873 points – the fourth‑largest daily drop on record – before the annual trend line was briefly reclaimed. Influenced by a steep decline in US equities overnight, Asian markets opened lower, with South Korean stocks triggering circuit breakers. Taiwan’s index opened with strong selling pressure, breaking the 40,000‑point psychological barrier and the annual trend line, sinking to a intraday low of 37,837.05 points, a drop of 3,737.67 points and a new record for the largest intraday fall. After the cabinet’s emergency market‑stability pledge, buying pressure helped the index swing within a 2,600‑point range, closing down 1,873.08 points (‑4.51%) at 39,701.64 points. Although the 40,000‑point level was lost, the decline narrowed sharply, marking the fourth‑largest closing drop ever, with total turnover rising to NT$1.246104 trillion.

The long‑running Da‑Tong–China Huaying dispute shows signs of resolution, with a potential recovery of nearly NT$10 billion in losses and an estimated pre‑tax earnings contribution of NT$4.6 per share. Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) announced on Monday (the 2nd) that after extensive negotiations and board approvals, both parties aim to settle with a settlement amount of RMB 7.68 billion (approximately NT$37.56 billion). If the settlement agreement is signed, the company could recoup close to NT$10 billion in losses, contributing about NT$4.6 per share to pre‑tax earnings.

paras_en: The market has recently been shaken by international developments, causing many stocks to fall. Investment trusts bought consecutively for seven sessions, netting 1,757 lots, while proprietary traders bought for 17 straight sessions, netting 3,090 lots.

Asus is benefiting from the global surge in AI computing power and cloud infrastructure. It has sharply raised its full‑year server revenue growth target from the previously forecast 100% to at least 150%, and it expects Q3 server revenue to rise 10‑15% quarter‑over‑quarter, delivering an annual increase of over 150%.

Asus notes that server profitability has entered a very healthy industry level. Over the next one to two years, the share of server revenue will continue to expand, and with memory and CPU supplies tight, manufacturers are prioritising servers first. Consequently, component shortages are markedly less severe than on the PC side, keeping overall operational impact manageable.

Regarding the next‑generation AI platform and growth momentum from Q4 into next year, Asus, as part of NVIDIA’s RTX SPARK launch lineup, has already sold out the initial batch of products such as the ProArt P16 and P14 through its distribution channels and is now placing additional orders with partners.

Asus previously said that this platform, together with the desktop and workstation‑grade DGX Station GR1X slated for launch in Q4, will deliver powerful edge‑inference compute, aligning closely with the Agentic AI development trend.
Asus will hold an investor briefing on November 12, during which it will discuss third‑quarter performance and future outlook.
